item.title: Hong Kong: AI-Enhanced Ultrasound for Faster, Safer Diagnostics
item.description: Researchers at the University of Hong Kong have developed a new smart ultrasound imaging technology designed to overcome a long-standing limitation in medical diagnostics caused by the human ribcage. item.title: India: C2S Accelerates Semiconductor Talent Development
item.description: India’s Chips to Startups (C2S) initiative is actively building a skilled semiconductor workforce while strengthening technology infrastructure and fostering innovation, entrepreneurship and global competitiveness.

item.title: NUS Singapore: Asia’s First Undergrad Geospatial Intelligence Programme
item.description: NUS Singapore will offer Asia’s first undergraduate programme in geospatial intelligence, equipping students with AI, advanced data analytics and spatial skills to tackle real-world challenges.

item.title: Malaysia: New Digital Platform Advances Smart Construction
item.description: Malaysia is modernising its construction sector with a new Digital Construction Management platform, significantly enhancing project coordination, productivity and transparency through integrated, data-driven tools.

item.title: India: Digital Reforms Propel Economic Growth, Competitiveness
item.description: India’s nationwide digital reforms streamline business processes, enhance regulatory efficiency and foster entrepreneurship, innovation, strengthening the country’s economic growth and appeal to investors.

item.title: Australia: Digital Health System Strengthens NSW Rural Healthcare
item.description: Remote monitoring technology analyses hospital patient data in real time, enabling earlier intervention, improving safety and strengthening healthcare delivery in rural communities.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Parenting Key to Children’s Online Safety
item.description: Central Visayas authorities are urging parents to strengthen digital parenting and actively guide children’s online activities to ensure their safety as cases of online sexual abuse and exploitation continue to rise.

item.title: Hong Kong: Tech Centre Fosters AI-Driven Healthcare Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong has launched the Future Life and Health Tech Centre to accelerate AI-driven innovation, biotechnology, and modernised traditional medicine, supporting commercialisation across life sciences.

item.title: Vietnam: Global AI Partnerships Drive Digital Transformation
item.description: Vietnam is strengthening international AI collaboration, with China’s Guangxi and European partners, to advance research, practical applications, talent development and its position as a regional technology hub.

item.title: Singapore: AI, Smart Technology for Next-Gen Maritime Sector
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its maritime competitiveness by leveraging AI, autonomous vessels, digital twins and advanced technology to enhance port operations, safety and overall global innovation.
